name: Hanako
source:
Yukie's caretaker, personal assistant, maid, and friend. She's taken care of Yukie her entire life. She's still only 14 years old and a second year student in middle school so there's a lot she still doesn't know. She has large breasts for a 14 year old.

She refuses to let Daisaku touch Yukie because doing so would be a crime, a huge crime! She slowly gives in to Yukie's desire to become closer to Daisaku however so long as whatever he does to Yukie he also does to herself so she can continue to watch over her mistress.
